coefficient_exponents.auxiliary: f=z; the fourth-power twist retains its zero when (am,z)>1, so the additional exclusion Q is 1
coefficient_exponents.inner_character_placement: kappa is on m in B_{k,z}^{varrho,kappa}(t,u)
coefficient_exponents.phase_limit: Only norm-exponent algebra is computationally checked here. Exact Gauss CRT phases and reciprocal-primary orientation are proved in the manuscript using the pinned sources.
coefficient_exponents.row_overlap: If (z,k)>1 the exterior coefficient is zero; no coprimality hypothesis between k and f was used in the raw norm.

growth.vertical_scope: Polynomial on each closed bounded real subregion with strict margins; the degree may depend on that subregion and the fixed source weight seminorms.

tests_frequencies_and_cusps.bad_indices: n0 is one of finitely many squarefree S-supported ideals away from lambda; b0 has arbitrary nonnegative valuations on the same fixed set; all j and unit sectors below are retained.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.cusp_phases: E_0(ell)=1 and E_-(ell)=E_+(ell)=breve-e(ell); the intrinsic additive phases are retained before fixed finite Fourier expansion.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.finite_character_support: varrho^3=conjugate(rho)^3 for each actual sector, with kappa=eta*rho^3; the group is fixed independently of k and the bad cube/ramified indices.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.frequency_decomposition: ell=epsilon*lambda^j*n0*n*(b0*b)^3; n,n0 squarefree, b,b0 arbitrary; (n,b)=1 is not required.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.frequency_lattice: ell in lambda^(-4) O_K, ell != 0, with every supported source cusp sector retained.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.good_indices: n,b are primary and avoid S; all physical raw indices and auxiliaries avoid S.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.limit: The finite table checks do not prove any imported theta coefficient or infinite cusp sum identity.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.raw_rows: All nonzero element rows in H<=Nk<2H, or any subset, with fixed reciprocity and unit classes retained.

raw_tests.class: Complex smooth functions of positive ideal norm, each compactly supported in a fixed interval inside (0,infinity).
raw_tests.dyadic_tests: W_t(x)=x^(-t)W_0(x), W_u(x)=x^(-u)W_0(x), and a fixed first block covering norm 1.
raw_tests.scales: H,F>=1; nonempty factor scales below 1 have a fixed support-dependent positive lower bound. The exact inverse allows every R>0, with its stratum support caps retained.
raw_tests.uniformity: Every required fixed derivative seminorm grows polynomially in Im(t),Im(u) on a bounded real strip. The counting theorem is used; no arbitrary row-dependent coefficient is allowed.

tests_frequencies_and_cusps.reunited_rows: Only the original squarefree primary k coprime to S; all-row B does not extend the scope of the exact source identity for Y.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.total_bad_label_mass: Bounded on strict Re(t)>1/6; the new domain has Re(t)>1/2. No cross-cusp terms are dropped in the row norm.
tests_frequencies_and_cusps.zero_frequency: Not included: Y and the reflected object here are the exact nonzero-frequency objects defined by PR #922.
